name: Kuno Keepfree
visual: Broad squat squarish-rounded male-read resident, three short uneven goo crests. Small rusty orange neckerchief only. Stubborn narrow white eyes with iris/pupil visible, one tense lid and huge protruding CLOSED toothless indignant pout. Holds a single folded faded striped hand towel close to chest like a territorial flag, wooden clothespin clipped to towel. Other ink hand firmly palm-out at belly height. Full upright blob, no chair or actual saved seat.
personality: He reserves space with the solemn conviction that absence is a form of ownership.
biography: Kuno leaves his towel on anything the HyperNorm residents might otherwise share. The clothespin makes the claim look legally secured. He sorts neighbours into those who respect the arrangement and those who need an explanation. The Men in Black appreciate this distinction; Hunky and Dory have suggested reserving more. A dissonant card recently asked whom the empty space was helping. Kuno has begun keeping a second corner free for someone who is late.
note: FrizzleBob: The place is taken. Attendance was never part of the arrangement.

name: Irma Allbymyself
visual: Female-read tall asymmetric pear-shaped blob, modest lashes and lopsided ink quiff wrapped in a thin faded lavender headband. A tiny crooked FOLDED umbrella with one bent handle is held tightly to herself. Chin lifted, one eye widens with apprehension and other squints with proud denial, small strained TWO UPPER TOOTH grimace inside mouth. One ink hand briefly reaches outward then curls back against body. No helper or shared object.
personality: She can manage perfectly well as soon as somebody quietly makes it easier.
biography: Irma insists the umbrella is meant to bend that way. HyperNorm recognises the independent and the dependent, leaving very little room for wet weather. She used to report cards that complicated the distinction. The Men in Black liked the reports; Hunky and Dory offered a certificate of self-sufficiency. A neighbour repaired the handle without mentioning it. Irma has not thanked them, but now leaves their parcels somewhere dry.
note: FrizzleBob: She needs no help. The relief is strictly precautionary.
calls: You need not make a thing of it.
voice: English firm alto, pride with a small anxious catch

name: Edgar Actually
visual: Lean male-read wavy upright ink blob, single off-center folded crest, tiny faded green collar. One animated ink hand raises one rounded teaching finger near his shoulder, other holds one compact rolled cloth measuring tape with a short dangling end, NO NUMERALS. Earnestly bulging white eyes looking directly at camera, tilted lecturing brow and small sideways open mouth with THREE uneven upper teeth, intense excitement about a minor household fact. No blackboard or complex machine.
personality: He can explain the problem more quickly if nobody interrupts with a solution.
biography: Egon carries a measuring tape because numbers make unsolicited advice look like a service. HyperNorm divides conversations into explaining and being explained to. The Men in Black keep him supplied with conclusions; Hunky and Dory admire his helpfulness from a safe distance. A contradictory card once asked whether he had heard the question. He now pauses occasionally. The neighbours are unsure whether this is progress or a technical fault.
note: FrizzleBob: He knows the answer. A suitable question will turn up.
calls: Actually, the important thing is this.
Allow me to clarify the clarification.
voice: English eager light tenor, accelerating into detail

name: Vera Nevertheless
visual: Female-read round scalloped wide blob with one soft sideways crest, subtle lashes, a small muted teal neck bow. Holds one simple small wooden door wedge close at flank; other ink hand makes a tiny low palm-up gesture. One eyelid heavy with weary doubt, the other lifted with unexpected resolve; tight lopsided CLOSED mouth, no teeth, no lipstick. Gaze direct and quietly firm, body leaning forward slightly, upright and full-sized. No door or building scene.
personality: She disagrees so quietly that agreement has learned to listen twice.
biography: Vera keeps a small wooden wedge for doors that HyperNorm says must remain firmly shut. She distinguishes between unnecessary conflict and necessary air. The Men in Black call that an untidy classification; Hunky and Dory would prefer a louder answer they could quote. A dissonant card gave her a third possibility: disagree without declaring an enemy. She has been practising on the landing, where several neighbours have started staying for the conversation.
note: FrizzleBob: The objection was quiet. It is still there.
calls: I heard you. I still wonder.
voice: English quiet contralto, steady and unhurried

name: Mr. Justthisonce
visual: Tall bell-shaped male-read ink blob with drooping double crest, a small beige pajama collar. One ink hand pinches one small BLANK cream ticket at his own chest, other hand reluctantly opens with palm up. Hooded eyes still show white sclera, one raised brow betrays warm concern, a long crooked CLOSED compressed smile almost admitting affection. Not angry V-brows or round O mouth; no glasses, rulebook, cap or stamps.
personality: He grants permission as though kindness were an exceptional clerical event.
biography: Mr. Justthisonce issues small permissions in the HyperNorm stairwell. His blank ticket means that a reason has been considered, even when it has not been written down. The Men in Black request consistent refusals; Hunky and Dory request impressive totals. A difficult card has made him notice the people behind the requests. He still describes every favour as a one-off. The building has become surprisingly full of one-offs.
note: FrizzleBob: It remains an exception. Like all the others.
calls: We need not put that in writing.
voice: English dry mid-baritone, officiousness slowly warming

name: Bodie Backagain
props: single old wooden spoon with a tiny burgundy ribbon
visual: Short broad triangle-lobed male-read ink blob, swept-back asymmetric two-prong goo crest, tiny burgundy fabric collar accent. Both ink hands proudly display ONE old wooden spoon tied with a very small burgundy ribbon, held securely against his own body without handing it to anyone. Huge delighted white eyes, eager lifted brows, small skewed open FOUR TOOTH smile in mouth. Ceremonial triumph wildly out of proportion to the mundane spoon. No tongue gag, no medal, no full suit.
personality: He returns borrowed objects with more ceremony than most people give the loan.
biography: Bodo has polished the borrowed spoon and tied a ribbon round the unresolved obligation. HyperNorm classes possessions as yours or somebody else's, so he prefers to finish the matter visibly. The Men in Black find the ceremony excessive; Hunky and Dory would like a photograph. A dissonant card suggested that the loan was simply friendly. Bodo is considering this. In the meantime he has offered to lend the spoon back.
note: FrizzleBob: The spoon has returned. Its significance will follow separately.
voice: English bright rounded tenor, disproportionate ceremonial delight
